units.title: Use directed diagonal intersections for equal side offsets
units.statement: For interior points T on AB and S on AD with AT=AS=s, the lines ST and BD meet at P=B+lambda(D-B), where lambda=(AB-s)/(AB-AD). Applying the same identity from the opposite vertex of a quadrilateral and using BT=BU and CU=CV yields AB+CD=BC+AD when the three lines have a nondegenerate common intersection.
steps: Express S and T as affine points on AD and AB
Solve for the intersection parameter on the line BD
Repeat from C and equate the directed parameters
